hooks.text: 生物特征消失后由时间操控技术复活，把死亡直接纳入空间站循环
hooks.excerpt: Through advanced time-manipulation, you’re brought back to life whenever your bio-metrics are no longer detected.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 收集死者记忆碎片可下载遗失技能，并把进度带过一次次电梯下行
hooks.excerpt: In the future where humans are able to download new abilities on demand, the station is now scattered with memory fragments from the fallen. Each one having the potential of being a lost skill or talent waiting to be unlocked. Every run offers a new pivoted challenge with ever-changing pathways to explore, and pits you against hordes of enemies. Each ride down the station's elevators carries forward progress from the memory fragments you scavenge along your exploration.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 越往空间站深处下潜，环境会愈发阴森，遭遇的敌人也越来越不像人类
hooks.excerpt: The deeper you descend into the station, the environments become more haunting, and the enemies less human.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
